description: This Java source file defines the SingleNoteWidgetFactory class, which implements the RemoteViewsFactory interface for an Android widget that displays a single note. The class manages fetching note data based on widget ID, creating RemoteViews with formatted note content, and handling widget lifecycle events.

classes.name: SingleNoteWidgetFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating RemoteViews for a single note widget, managing data retrieval and view creation.

methods.description: Initializes the factory; no operation needed here.

methods.description: Fetches the latest note data from the repository based on the widget ID.

methods.description: Returns 1 if a note is available to display, otherwise 0.

methods.description: Creates and returns a RemoteViews object for the note, including setting click intent and formatted content.
